text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Emir opens new Shura council, hails unity of Bahrain's people. The 40-member council was appointed on Saturday to replace a 30-member body named in late 1992.
- Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates and Yemen voice support for Bahrain's measures to maintain security and stability.
- Bahrain calls for Gulf Arab states to resolve their border disputes.
- An Indian team is due to arrive in Bahrain on Wednesday for talks with Bahraini businessmen.
